title: ADscan artifact manifest v1
description: Every file a run left in its workspace, with its egress class from adscan_core/node_link/artifact_classes.py. 'unlisted' is a file no classification rule covers: it never leaves a scanner node under any data policy. Paths are workspace-relative and may name AD objects (a domain directory), so the manifest itself stays on the node unless the data policy allows findings.

generated_at_frame.$comment: Which clock generated_at came from (adscan_core/reporting/clock_frame.py): the host clock may be stepped to a domain controller mid-run.

path.$comment: Workspace-relative POSIX path; never absolute, never '..'.

redaction_required.$comment: The content can embed a secret: may leave only after the field-level redactor and the known-secret scanner (artifact_classes.may_leave). The sha256 is over the unredacted content.

hash_skipped.$comment: Why no digest: never for a secret or unlisted file (a digest of a short secret or loot file is crackable), past the size cap or the time budget, or unreadable.
